title: Bound P104 public MOVE fusion contacts (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On the exact #7277 word, all 4,732 consecutive public MOVE windows contain a nonsilent scalar contact. The independent denominator-safe audit certifies all 7,721 distinct contacts. All 1,922 windows with one intervening ADD also fail the separate common-lift condition. The other operand's first later contact is never the required existing direct B→C MOVE. Both scopes are exhausted with zero unresolved cases.

The complete 17-copy pre-support savings uppers are about 363.3275462698572 and 199.18473699786647 raw units. Each upper counts an old MOVE at most once and grants added costs free. After exact support both uppers are zero.

Registered replay, committed bytes/modes/source history, six navigation tests and the Git-free export passed locally. The standalone replay authenticates eight exact public source files and reproduces six full deterministic receipts by plaintext SHA-256. Use its optional `--out fresh-receipts` to materialize the full evidence. The modified caller was rejected. A changed native, caller and outer replay did not run because no literal candidate survived.
